exposure: insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 1 (iGFBP-1) in cervical secretions
cohort: 140 pregnant women undergoing induction of labor for various indications at term pregnancy.
finding: Successful induction of labor was significantly correlated with detection of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein 1 (iGFBP-1) in cervical secretions and measurement of cervical length by transvaginal ultrasound.
